summary: The WK-23-2052 Drum Clinometer is similar to WK-23-2054, but has a range of 10° to 0° to 90°. It fits easily into small storage and operational space. It is used worldwide by aircraft manufacturers, maintenance facilities, and aerospace services. Supplied with a durable plastic carrying case.
